enchantments.tooltip: Armor Bonus +10: This item surrounds the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting +10 armor bonus to AC, just as though he were wearing armor.
+11 Enhancement Bonus: +11 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Deathblock: The wearer of this item is immune to all death spells and magical death effects.
Fortification +130%: +130% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.

Ghostly: Equipping this item causes you to become partially incorporeal. Your melee attacks do not roll a miss chance for Incorporeal targets. Enemy attacks have a 10% chance to miss you due to incorporeality. You receive a +5 enhancement bonus to your Hide and Move Silently skills.
From The Shadows: On Being Missed in Combat: Chance to do 10 to 60 Negative Energy Damage to the Attacker.
Flawed Shadowscale Armor: This Shadowscale Armor is not at its full potential. Another run through the forge could improve it.
